study_characteristics.study_objective: Use normative modeling to quantify individual age-related deviations in functional (emotion-matching fMRI) and structural MRI in youths with disruptive behavior disorders, and integrate deviations across modalities via linked ICA to relate to aggression.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Deviation counts compared with Mann–Whitney U with FDR control; PALM used for group differences on deviation maps (FWE-corrected). Linked ICA (20 components) on unthresholded Z maps; logistic models (AIC/BIC) predicted DBD caseness; component 8 negatively associated with aggression (p=0.003) controlling for outliers.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: DBD youths showed greater positive age-related deviations in amygdala during face processing; multimodal deviations (DMN, amygdala, striatum) related to aggression, and linked ICA explained ~23% variance in DBD phenotype.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Normative modeling revealed widespread individual positive deviations in face-processing regions (including amygdala) among cases despite modest group averages. Linked ICA integrating functional and anatomical deviations produced components predictive of DBD status with superior fit (AIC=173.9, BIC=233.6) versus raw-data components and explained 23% of variance in clinical DBD phenotype; component 8 (DMN and subcortical contributions) was negatively associated with aggression (p=0.003).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Modest sample restricts reference modeling (TD-only reference not feasible in the intersection); cross-sectional design limits developmental inference; potential sex differences could not be formally tested; emotion task mixing neutral/positive faces may dilute effects; inclusion via CBCL clinical aggression scores increases heterogeneity.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Combines normative modeling (GPR; out-of-sample CV) with scanner harmonization (ComBat) and multimodal linked ICA on unthresholded deviation maps; thresholded NPMs at |Z|≥2.6 to characterize individual atypicality.

general_notes.general_notes: Sensitivity analysis using larger anatomical dataset (N=248) showed similar results when using whole-sample vs controls-only reference (Table S4). Five fMRI sites retained to ensure ≥5 cases and controls per site before QC. No explicit software package for GPR normative modeling reported.
